name: Cosmic Guidance
body:
You can gain a brief boost over your fate, empowered by your deep insights into the cultivation of spiritual power.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, and Cosmic Clarity.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic guidance ability.

Cosmic Guidance (Su)

Once per day, as a free action, whenever you make a d20 roll, you may add a bonus equal to 1/2 your HD to the result. You can only use this ability on the roll before you learn if the roll is a success or not.

Special: You may expend 3 ki points or 3 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic guidance. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic guidance in this way once for every 5 HD you possess.
